_about: PLACEHOLDER memo lines for the boss fights, shown as battle messages. The Writer replaces them in M6-2; the tone (docs/tone_guide.md) is chilling-funny: Kasp sounds like an office manager and means every word. Keys per boss id: start (when the fight begins), rig_turn / foot_turn (on his turn, with the chance set by the enemy's line_chance), low_hp (foot phase, under low_hp_pct), pulse (the Quiet Hours jam pulse goes off), leg_break (by_count: one line each time another pair breaks, 1 to 4), leg_flip (a pair broken by Heave-Ho; optional), topple (the rig goes over), foot_start (he climbs out), defeat (he is beaten). Not here on purpose: his spec-sheet lines about the dish, which belong to the Writer.

start: Eight legs. Hydraulic knees. Heated seat. Cupholder. You are about to be defeated by a cupholder, courier.
MEMO. Effective immediately, you are pending.
rig_turn: Let's circle back to your surrender. I've pencilled it in.
Nobody's in trouble, friends. Trouble requires paperwork. You're just... pending.
Heated seat: on. Cupholder: occupied. Mercy: out of stock.
Every one of those cues is a noise violation. I'm writing them all up.
I'd hate to have to ink it.
pulse: MEMO. Quiet Hours are now in effect. Please stop hearing things.
Quiet Hours. Rhythm is a noise. Noise is a violation.
Effective now, the beat is cancelled.

by_count: That leg was under warranty. The warranty was a noise violation.
Four legs. The spec sheet still says eight. I'm not amending the spec sheet.
Six legs, down. This is a stagger, not a fall. I will be filing it as a stagger.
Seven. Eight. I'd like it noted that I did not scream.

leg_flip: Did he just FLIP my leg? That is a hydraulic knee. It does not do that.
topple: Rig status: horizontal. Filing a form for it.
This is not a fall. This is an unscheduled descent.
foot_start: I still have the clipboard. The clipboard was always the point.
foot_turn: Let's circle back to your surrender. On foot. In person.
Trouble requires paperwork. I have the paperwork. It is on me.
You will not be taking my stripe. It is stitched on. I checked.
low_hp: This is not a retreat. It is a strategic withdrawal from a position I am still standing in.
Eleven years. Eleven years, and it ends on a roof, by a courier.
defeat: I would like to dispute this outcome. In writing. In triplicate. Please hold.
